title: Training package request
openingNarrative: A distributor wants a shortened Code Pink/Blue training cut. The pitch drops communication access, delirium, restraint review, school exclusion, home staffing, and privacy — keeping only ‘mechanics’. Rohan can respond via AAC. This beat is about ownership of lived-experience framing, not a clinical win.
clinicalState: Post-event media and training request. Rohan addressable. No doses or energies.
